title: Adapting Chat Language Models Using Only Target Unlabeled Language Data

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing task performance (e.g., accuracy, chrF, exact match) and inference efficiency (tokens/second) across seven typologically diverse, underrepresented languages versus high-resource languages like English.
Measuring the percentage of benign versus harmful sentences generated by the model using translated versions of the ToxicGen and ImplicitHate datasets across different target languages.
